title: Soft Pretzels, Ready‑to‑Eat, Cinnamon Sugar Coated

content.title: About
content.content: Soft pretzels are a ready‑to‑eat baked snack coated with a cinnamon‑sugar mixture. They are tender inside, slightly crisp outside, and have a sweet‑spicy aroma. Convenient for on‑the‑go consumption, they require no further preparation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The classic pretzel shape dates back to medieval monasteries, symbolizing crossed arms in prayer.
Soft pretzels are a popular treat at movie theaters and fairs.
The cinnamon‑sugar coating enhances aroma and appeals especially to children.
In the United States, sweet soft pretzels gained popularity in the 1970s with the rise of fast‑food chains.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Pretzels provide quickly digestible carbs that can give an immediate energy boost.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: A modest amount of fiber supports digestive health.

items.title: Antioxidants from cinnamon
items.content: Cinnamon is rich in polyphenols that have antioxidant properties.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Large amounts of sugar can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of tooth decay.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Pretzels made from wheat flour contain gluten and are unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Allergy to additives
items.content: Some versions may contain flavorings or preservatives that can trigger allergic reactions.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pretzels can be enjoyed as a standalone snack, paired with yogurt or ice cream, or used in dessert recipes. They are easy to pack in a bag or backpack.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store soft pretzels in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days. For longer storage keep them refrigerated, though they may lose some softness.
